jobs.occupation: Functional Analyst - Supply Chain Microsoft Dynamics 365
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Manuchar we are transforming towards our state-of-the-art 2.0 platform and ERP plays a crucial role in this journey! At the moment we have around 40 different ERP-system and the goal is to move all affiliates to Microsoft Dynamics 365. This is a long journey that won’t happen overnight. 

We are therefore looking to onboard a D365 Functional Expert in Supply Chain modules to join our Commercial Off the Shelf team.

Your responsibilities are:

• Analyze existing systems and business models
• Recommend resolutions and improvements
• Provide consolidate findings on components or processes
• Ensure security by design
• Shape documentation
• Provide advanced, component technical support
• 
Resolve issues prior to and following testing

 

What do you need to be successful in your mission?

• You have minimum 5 years of experience as Functional Expert on D365 Supply Chain Modules
• Actual experience in configuring SCM modules
• Knowledge and experience implementing those models
• Knowledge of Dual-Write with the ERP D365 FO SCM
• You are hands-on with a ‘can do attitude’
• You are proactive, adaptive and thinking in terms of solutions
• You are flexible and paying attention to details
• You are structured.
• You are credible and reliable & can influence and convince the organization with an in-depth argumentation and demonstration.
• You are a dynamic team player.
• You are able to work in a fast-paced and quickly changing environment.
• 
You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch, Spanish and Portuguese is a plus.

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!  

You are fully convinced that data science isn’t a hype, but you also believe that, in order to be valuable and really make a company smarter, it must be done right. Your goal is therefore to create the most impactful solution possible in the quickest and easiest way possible so that real value can be extracted from data and artificial intelligence.  

 

We’re looking for someone who has: 

• A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related field. 
• 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience developing and implementing AI/ML models in production environments. 
• Strong Python programming skills, including experience with API-building frameworks such as FastAPI and prototyping tools like Streamlit. 
• Experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar is considered a strong asset. 
• Solid understanding of machine learning including model evaluation techniques and familiarity with advanced applications such as: NLP, forecasting, optimization, computer vision. 
• Experience in working with cloud-based environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and ML pipelines is a strong asset. 
• Experience with Generative AI technologies, prompt engineering, and large language models, is a strong asset. 
• Hands-on knowledge of vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Azure AI Search) for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines is a strong asset. 
• Strong communication and business analysis skills and genuinely interested in understanding the customer’s business context and challenges.
• You can explain complex technical concepts in simple, accessible language to non-technical stakeholders. 
• A collaborative, open-minded mindset and a drive to keep learning in a fast-evolving field.
• 
You're fluent in Dutch or French, as well as English.

Responsibilities

• Develop customized ERP functionalities
• Analyze client requirements and translate them into technical or functional solutions
• Manage full ERP implementations for SME clients
• Provide technical and application support (via internal ticketing system)
• Write and execute SQL queries for data management
• Collaborate closely with internal teams and clients
• 
Contribute to upgrades, maintenance, and system evolution phases

 

Profile

• Proven experience in a technical or functional ERP-related role
• Solid knowledge of SQL (both reading and writing)
• Skills in software development (particularly C#) and/or business process analysis, depending on the position
• Strong understanding of business processes (accounting, supply chain, production, etc.)
• Autonomy, attention to detail, analytical mindset, and problem-solving orientation
• Comfortable communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, both internal and external
• 
Fluent Dutch required; English is mandatory for some roles; French is a plus

Your mission

At Manuchar we are transforming towards our state-of-the-art 2.0 platform and ERP plays a crucial role in this journey! At the moment we have around 40 different ERP-system and the goal is to move all affiliates to Microsoft Dynamics 365. This is a long journey that won’t happen overnight. 

We are therefore looking to onboard a D365 Expert in HR modules to join our Commercial Off the Shelf team. Code named the "ERP for HR" project.

Your responsibilities are:

• Analyze existing systems and business models
• Recommend resolutions and improvements
• Provide consolidate findings on components or processes
• Ensure security by design
• Shape documentation
• Provide advanced, component technical support
• 
Resolve issues prior to and following testing

 

What do you need to be successful in your mission?

• You have minimum 3 years of experience as functional expert of D365 FO HRM Modules
• Experience implementing Dynamics 365 FO HRM solutions
• Knowledge in the following modules: Fundamentals, Compensation Management, Recruitment, Onboarding, Case Management, Performance Management, Competency Management, LMS integration and Payroll interfacing
• You are hands-on with a ‘can do attitude’
• You are proactive, adaptive and thinking in terms of solutions
• You are flexible and paying attention to details
• You are structured.
• You are credible and reliable & can influence and convince the organization with an in-depth argumentation and demonstration.
• You are a dynamic team player.
• You are able to work in a fast-paced and quickly changing environment.
• 
 You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch, Spanish and Portuguese is a plus.

Vinçotte is the market leader in Belgium and offers objective and advisory services in inspection, certification, conformity assessment and training. Our team of over 1,500 professionals is committed to a safer and more efficient society. Our sector specialists understand the needs of customers perfectly and guide them along the way with advice and support. Aiming for results for multinationals, SMEs, self-employed persons and private persons is what makes our blood flow. We are looking for a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) to join our team in Vilvoorde.

Ready to level up your career and secure the digital world? As a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) you’ll be the go-to expert managing our network and security infrastructure – across our campus, datacenter, and Microsoft Azure environment.

What will you do?

• Take charge of our network & security landscape, both on-prem and in the cloud (Azure).
• Provide Level 2 support for complex IT network issues.
• Dive into IT projects related to your area of expertise.
• Work autonomously in an agile setup with a clear backlog and strategic focus.
• Help improve documentation and technical guidelines.
• Detect, assess, and fix security risks – you're our digital guardian.
• Manage and fine-tune spam filters to keep our communications safe.

Experience:

• You've already rolled up your sleeves in network and firewall management — think design, setup, config, upgrades — and you know your way around operational environments.
• You’re certified in Azure, have experience with it, or you're eager to dive in and grow into a true Azure pro.
• You’re ready to become our in-house expert on Microsoft Security tools — managing, fine-tuning, and pushing them to keep cyber threats out.
• You're curious about Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and see it as a powerful tool in building fast, scalable, modern environments.
• You believe solid processes are the backbone of great IT — and you embrace ITIL best practices to keep things running smoothly and smartly.
• You hold an IT bachelor degree and have 2-3 years of relevant experience in the following domains:
• Routing & Switching: Aruba and / or Cisco
• Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) : Fortinet, Check Point or Palo Alto
• Reverse Proxy : BlueCoat, Fortiweb or Azure Application GW
• SASE/SDWAN: CATO, Fortinet, zScaler or Pallo Alto
• Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) CATO and / or zScaler
• Cloud Networking & Security: Azure 
• Network Access Control (802.1X Wired/Wireless, RADIUS, TACACS, Guest Portals)
• Vulnerability management: Nessus, MS Defender or Qualys
• Network Detection and Response (NDR): Darktrace 
• Extended Detection and Response (XDR): MS Defender and / or Sentinelone, 
• Spam filtering: MS Defender, Barracuda or Cisco Ironport 

Personality:

• You don’t wait around — when something’s blocking the business, you jump in and fix it fast.
• You’re all about progress: positive mindset, always learning, always improving, and staying sharp on the latest tech trends.
• Agile is your jam — you thrive in sprints, love a good retro, and believe great things happen when teams grow together.
 

Languages:

• Dutch or French? Check. English? No problem — you’re fluent in the language of international teamwork.

Role
As a Data Architect, you will work for our client to design, manage, and optimize complex data structures and systems. You will define data strategies aligned with the organization’s vision, ensure data integrity and scalability, and establish standards for data governance. You translate stakeholder needs into technical solutions and provide clear documentation so that each stakeholder can understand the data model from their perspective. You embrace innovation by implementing new technologies and data analytics tools, always in compliance with applicable regulations.

 

Profile
• At least 3 years of experience as a data architect
• Deep knowledge of data architecture, data and application lifecycle management, CI/CD, and big data technologies
• Experience with Data Lake, Governance and Management
• Strong communication skills, both independently and in a team setting
• Familiar with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Lean)
• Fluent in either Dutch or French, with at least a basic understanding of the other national language and English
• Analytical mindset, solution-oriented, and eager to keep up with industry trends
• 
Able to coach junior and medior data architects and collaborate across teams

We are looking for a talented and passionate Rust Developer to join our dynamic technical team. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in high-performance software development, with particular expertise in the Rust programming language. You will work on exciting and innovative projects, ranging from designing high-performance tools to building distributed applications, while ensuring security, reliability, and scalability of the systems.

 

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain applications using Rust in high-performance environments.
• Collaborate with team members (software engineers, architects, and PMs) to define technical specifications and ensure code quality.
• Write unit, integration, and performance tests to ensure the robustness of the product.
• Participate in code reviews and ensure the quality of the code shared with other team members.
• Optimize application performance by identifying and solving bottlenecks.
• Analyze technical requirements and propose innovative solutions adapted to the company’s needs.
• Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation for code and development processes.
 

Required Skills:

• Strong expertise in Rust with solid experience in building high-performance applications.
• Good knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems, and modern tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
• Experience in memory management and systems programming (thread management, resource handling, etc.).
• Familiarity with agile development practices and associated tools (Git, CI/CD, etc.).
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
• Proficiency in technical English.
Desired Skills:

• Experience with databases (SQL or NoSQL).
• Familiarity with Rust web frameworks (e.g., Actix, Rocket).
• Knowledge of security and cryptography principles in distributed systems.
• Experience with other programming languages such as C, Go, Python, or JavaScript.

We are looking for an AWS Data Engineer with experience in building, monitoring and maintaining reliable and secure data solutions in AWS. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Business Consultants to deliver value to our clients.

 
Your responsibilities
• Build and maintain data infrastructure (e.g. ELT, generic data pipelines, interfaces between data products)
• Translate business needs into well-designed, maintainable data solutions
• Balance cost, performance, and maintainability when designing new or improving on existing solutions
• Implement production-ready solutions (e.g. deployment automation, monitoring, alerting)
• Stay up to date with developments in data technology and share your knowledge with your colleagues
• Coach junior and medior data engineers
 
Your qualifications
Must have

• You have at least 4 years of experience.
• Hands-on experience with implementing data solutions in AWS.
• You can build and maintain infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
• Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker)
• Hands-on experience with networking, security, and access control in AWS.
• You can set up and maintain deployment automation pipelines and have day-to-day experience with Git (using GitHub, GitLab, or similar)
• You get energy from writing and maintaining clean, well-structured Python code
• You have contributed to production-grade deployments
 

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with data modeling (Kimball, Data Vault)
• Hands-on experience with container orchestration (ECS/AKS/GKE, Kubernetes)
• Strong analytical SQL skills
• Knowledge of data warehousing best practices
• Hands-on experience with dbt
 

Languages

Fluent in English, and Dutch or French

As a Data Architect at Sopra Steria, you will play a key role in shaping data strategies and designing end-to-end solutions for clients across various industries. You will define and implement data architectures that support business objectives, ensuring scalability, security, and performance. By analysing customer needs and translating them into robust data models and frameworks, you’ll deliver solutions that turn data into actionable insights. Leveraging your expertise across the entire data value chain, you will guide clients through their digital transformation journey and support the successful implementation of Sopra Steria’s diverse portfolio of data services.

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• You have a background in Data Engineering or Data Analyses.
• At least 3 years of experience as a Data Architect.
• You are able to design and set up end-to-end data solutions.
• You collect, analyze and match customer demand with a meaningful design.
• You have good knowledge and experience with SQL, Data modeling concepts and ETL best practices.
• You have practical experience with Microsoft cloud or comparable alternatives.
• Knowledge of a programming language like Python is a plus.
• Experience with using and implementing AI in your and the client’s workflow is a plus.
• You have analytical thinking, communication skills and a practical attitude.
• You are proficient in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a must.

We are looking for a Network Engineer with a strong focus on Azure Cloud to help design, evolve, and operate our customers hybrid network infrastructures. You will play a key role in integrating on-premises environments with Azure in a secure, scalable, and highly available way.

In this role, you combine deep networking expertise with strong knowledge of Azure networking services, working closely with Cloud, Security, and Architecture teams. You take ownership of complex network topics and help shape a modern, cloud-ready and future-proof infrastructure.

Your days will consist of automating and maintaining the systems of our customers, as well as optimize our infrastructure and align cloud systems to serve our business goals. You’ll use your expertise in cloud platforms, automation frameworks, containerization, virtualization, networking, and security practices to drive digital transformation.

Our goal is to build reliable and cost-efficient systems. As a Network Engineer, you’ll make it happen by designing, implementing, and supporting scalable cloud environments.

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent
• At least 4 years of experience as a Network Engineer
• Proven experience of Cloud networking in hybrid network architectures (Azure, AWS)
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and Cloud architecture principles.
• Experience implementing, monitoring and troubleshooting Azure building blocks (ExpressRoute, VPN gateways, Azure DNS,…).
• Implement and maintain network security solutions, including firewalls, network segmentation and Zero-Trust environments.
• Practice of Automation tools is an asset.
• Fluent in English, French and Dutch
Preferred Qualifications

• Relevant professional certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Network Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CCNA/CCNP.
• Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Ansible, Terraform, ARM templates).
• 
Clear written and oral communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects, ensuring alignment with business goals.
• Define project scope, objectives, timelines, and resource requirements.
• Manage budgets, risks, and dependencies throughout the project lifecycle.
• Coordinate and motivate cross-functional teams to achieve project milestones.
• Ensure effective communication with stakeholders and provide regular progress updates.
• Identify potential issues and proactively implement solutions.
• Guarantee quality standards and compliance with company processes and methodologies.
• Conduct post-project evaluations to capture lessons learned and improve future performance.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree/Master's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, IT, Engineering, or related field.
• Proven experience as a Project Manager 3 in IT
• Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
• Strong leadership and communication abilities.
• Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Asana, Trello).
• Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
• PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum certification is a plus.
• Languages: Fluent in French & English OR Dutch & English.

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

• Master’s degree in a technical or scientific field (industrial, civil, or bio-engineering)
• Experience in a pharmaceutical and/or GMP environment is a strong asset
• Knowledge of validation processes and sterile production is a plus
• Strong organizational and communication skills
• Ability to work independently and take initiative
• Team player with analytical thinking skills
• Affinity with technical, technological, and process-related aspects
• Flexible and resilient in a dynamic project environment
• Experience in project coordination and contractor management is a plus
• 
Good command of English is required and Dutch is a plus

 

Profile

As a quality and compliance expert, you will be responsible for ensuring that GxP systems and processes adhere to the applicable regulatory requirements throughout the entire system lifecycle. Therefore, you stay up to date about evolving regulations from authorities such as the EMA and FDA and industry standards like GAMP and ISO. Depending on your role and expertise, you may be asked to provide Quality & Compliance support during audits and inspections, or to join a Sopra Steria validation service team.

Are you a technically skilled engineer with a passion for pharmaceutical processes? As a Project Engineer, you will contribute to various engineering projects. You’ll be responsible for the full project lifecycle of specific installations or equipment: from specification and procurement to installation, validation, and handover to operations. You’ll work in multidisciplinary teams, monitor planning and budget, and ensure safe, compliant, and efficient execution. You’ll also be part of creating technical solutions and be included in the technical follow-up with suppliers. You take ownership of your scope, communicate proactively with stakeholders, and contribute to continuous improvement.

As an AI Engineer, you bring traditional and Generative AI into real world use cases by helping our clients design, build, and serve Generative AI solutions. You design and implement solutions that require from traditional AI to LLMs, from semantic search to conversational AI. You train, fine-tune, improve, and deploy ML models. Furthermore, you write production ready code to serve online, batch, and real time models. You build applications and software to serve AI driven use cases.  

You work in close collaboration with Data Scientists, MLOps Engineers and Data Engineers, to integrate all parts of the solution. You help build solutions and/or operate with our clients on a medium to long-term basis. 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in AI consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. You will be part of the Data & AI team, where we tackle AI challenges end to end, from strategy, governance, to science and engineering. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

 

 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• At least 3 years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, MLOps Engineer, or in a similar position 
• Experience with traditional NLP, LLMs, and conversational AI, both in experimentation phase and in production 
• Experience with vector databases for semantic search and RAG solutions in a production environment. 
• Strong software engineering background and ability to write production ready code in Python 
• Experience with experiment tracking, models monitoring, LLM and NLP evaluation techniques, and deployment strategies 
• Comfortable with the machine learning lifecycle and MLOps and DevOps principles 
• Experience with at least one cloud provider and good knowledge of the data ecosystem 
• Able to coach others, give technical advice and direction, and work independently 
• Master or PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
• Proficient in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Our Belgian SAP BI & Data team is made up of a dynamic and passionate group of individuals. With a collective experience ranging from 2 to +20 years, our colleagues have dedicated a significant portion of their careers to Capgemini, showing how much we love it here. From database migrations to data warehouses and dynamic reporting, we take it upon ourselves to maximize data-potential and empower our customers to extract the most value from their data.

Your role

As a Data Migration Expert (SAP), you'll be at the forefront of designing and executing data migration strategies that ensure smooth and efficient transitions across systems. Your role will be pivotal in overseeing data migration projects, from initial planning through to execution and validation. You'll ensure that data is accurately and securely transferred between systems, maintaining integrity and consistency throughout the process. Utilizing advanced tools like SAP migration cockpit and EMIGALL, you’ll streamline migration workflows and resolve any challenges that arise. If you’re passionate about orchestrating complex data migrations and want to lead in a cutting-edge environment, this position is for you.

Key tasks & activities

• You act as an experienced data migration consultant on data migration and data governance projects. You engage in a diverse range of activities, including delivery planning, data gathering, data cleansing and validation, development, testing, and execution of the migration.
• You interact with clients during workshops and trainings, forming the key link between customer requirements and technical solutions.
• You lead the implementation team, offering guidance and training to junior members while ensuring strict adherence to the project plan.
• You work closely with your project manager and the project team, but also with functional colleagues to create the best solution possible. You act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
• 
You provide support in proposals, product developments, and further research around Data Solutions

 

Knowledge & Experience

• You have a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in executing (SAP) migration projects, showcasing extensive analytical skills and technical knowledge on end-to-end migration lifecycles.
• You have acquired skills within:
• Data analysis: ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and quality of the migrated data by cleansing, transforming and validating data. This requires the use of data analysis languages such as SQL, and data analysis tools such as MS Excel or Access.
• Data migration: planning, executing and managing the migration of data from legacy systems to new target environments. This involves ensuring seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading processes, which requires proficiency in data migration tools such as S/4HANA migration cockpit, Emigall and/or LSMW. Knowledge of ETL tools as SAP Data services or Datasphere is a plus.
• Data migration planning: Strong team management skills are necessary to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams, ensuring that all members are aligned with project goals and timelines. This includes delegating tasks appropriately, providing guidance and support, fostering a collaborative work environment, and managing stakeholder expectations.
• You possess knowledge on one or more of the main functional areas within a business, e.g., sales & distribution, purchasing, material management, financial management, and Human capital management.
• You are a proactive, results-driven team player with strong communication skills, a customer-oriented approach, and a consultancy mindset, capable of collaborating with diverse colleagues and confidently representing Capgemini to clients.
• Resident in Belgium.
• Fluent in Dutch/French and English.
• Geographic mobility. We serve customers throughout Belgium.

About Capgemini
Capgemini is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services. The Group is at the forefront of innovation to address the entire breadth of clients’ opportunities in the evolving world of cloud, digital and platforms. Building on its strong 50-year+ heritage and deep industry-specific expertise, Capgemini enables organizations to realize their business ambitions through an array of services from strategy to operations. Capgemini is driven by the conviction that the business value of technology comes from and through people. Today, it is a multicultural company of 300,000 team members in almost 50 countries.
 

Key tasks & activities
As an experienced SAP PS/PPM (Project Systems/ Project & Portfolio Management) functional consultant, you will be responsible for translating the business challenges of our customers into IT requirements based on SAP’s latest technologies in the area of PS and/or PPM. As part of a team of consultants, you will guide your customer in implementing, testing and delivering the solution.

Knowledge & Experience

• Master’s degree
• A good knowledge of the SAP solution portfolio for PS and/or PPM
• +3 years of experience in SAP PS and/or PPM
• SAP trainings or certifications are an asset
• Team player with strong communication skills and with a collaborative spirit
• Able to coach, support, train and develop junior consultants
• Customer oriented, result driven & focused on delivering quality
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English
• Willing to work on assignments in Belgium and potentially abroad
• Belgian residency

Are you looking for a new challenging role where you can have a positive impact on digital transformation journey's ? Join us today as SAP Plant Maintenance Consultant.

 

YOUR ROLE

• SAP PM Configuration: Configure and customize PM to align with maintenance processes and business requirements
• Preventive Maintenance Planning: Develop and manage strategies, including work order scheduling, to reduce equipment downtime and extend asset lifecycles
• Data Management: Maintain accurate master data, equipment records, and maintenance task lists within SAP PM to support informed decision-making and efficient maintenance operations
• Business knowledge of maintenance and service processes, and strategic asset management

• Team Management: mentor junior PM consultants of various levels of expertise; providing guidance, training, and support to enhance their skills and contribute to project success

YOUR PROFILE

• A bachelor's or master's degree combined with 5+ years of SAP project experience
• Experience in SAP Plant Maintenance configuration, implementation and optimization
• Analytical problem-solving abilities to identify issues and propose innovative solutions
• Knowledge of QM, EH&S, MRS, Work Force Management, Logistics, S/4HANA Service or CRM is an added value
• A collaborative spirit & customer-oriented attitude
• Result-driven & focused on delivering quality
• Fluency in French or Dutch and professional working proficiency in English

CONTEXT

Your role will be to help challenge and define the implementation scope and approach, to bring best practices and pitfalls from previous experiences and to implement functional solution , in coordination with our other consultants and the development team. You should also be able to quickly assess the customer’s needs, propose a standard-first solution and advice the project manager, solution architect and functional team.

As an experienced consultant, you will coach one or more junior consultants and train them (either in classroom or on the job) in CRM and general consulting skills.

Work with clients to translate complex business challenges into IT requirements

• Design sustainable solutions based on SAP's latest technologies

Coach, train & support junior consultants in the process

Experience

• Experience in customizing and implementing SAP CRM processes
• Knowledge of SAP CRM on premise
• Knowledge of SAP S/4 Service
• Knowledge SAP CX suite is an asset

Skills

Full-time employment with Capgemini Belgium. Working from the client locations across Flanders is mandatory, remote activities are possible.

Official language is Dutch, English is needed for interaction with Capgemini and SAP

Join the Powerhouse of Innovation at Capgemini's SAP Application Maintenance & Development Department and be part of revolutionizing business operations through optimized SAP systems!

As a SAP Service Delivery Manager you will be responsible for all SAP related projects and all SAP related improvement services at the client. You will be responsible for project delivery, service delivery, people management and the client relationship. You will perform a combination of Project Management and Service Delivery Management task

As you will be responsible of ensuring the qualitative delivery of the agreed services to the partner, you will have to make sure your team will be performing as expected and helping them evolve.

• Foster strong interpersonal and team spirit for collaborative delivery.
• Implement structured processes to meet contractual service levels effectively.
